    Hybrians

    The Master Plan¶

    The Shadows' goal has not changed in three million years. Their strategy on Ge'or operates in six phases:

    Phase 1 — Infiltration: Develop Ge'or covertly. Turn fragmented tribes into centralized states. Create the institutions that will one day be used to control them.

    Phase 2 — Fragmentation: Foster wars between nations. Prevent unification. A divided world is easier to manipulate.

    Phase 3 — Consolidation: Gain power country by country. Create alliance blocks that are secretly controlled by Shadow agents or willing collaborators.

    Phase 4 — Unification: Unify the entire world under a covert dictatorship. The nation-state, the church, the military — all report to the same hidden masters.

    Phase 5 — Assimilation: Develop the magical system (technology) to create a planetary hivemind incorporating every soul on Ge'or. Absorb all Ge'orians into the Shadow consciousness.

    Phase 6 — Victory: Restart The Last Great War. This time, win.

    The Shadows are patient. They have been working on Ge'or for approximately 3,600 years since their arrival (2989 BGD to 597 AGD). They will work for another 3,600 if necessary.

    The Plan in Practice — Historical Milestones¶

    Phase 1 in Action — The First Millennium¶

    The first thousand years after the Pontus crash were spent in silence. The Shadows did not act. They watched. From their subterranean base, they studied every continent, every species, every political fault line. They created the first Homunculi — bio-engineered infiltrators indistinguishable from real people. They established a secret cult follower base among the surface population — humans and others who learned of the Shadows and chose to serve them willingly.

    By the end of Phase 1, Shadow agents were embedded in every major population center on Erisdar.

    Phase 2 in Action — The Long Game¶

    Over the next 1,568 years, the Shadows built a global network of influence without ever revealing themselves. Using homunculi agents, willing collaborators, and manipulated historical figures, they shaped the course of civilizations through subtle intervention.

    They did not conquer. They nudged.

    • Kings were advised by Shadow agents. Generals' strategies were subtly altered. Prophets received Shadow-sent visions.
    • Wars were engineered. Alliances were broken.
    • The fall of the Old Lumina Empire (1134 BGD) was a Phase 2 operation. Luminous XII's defeat at the hands of the Goblin King was not misfortune — the Shadows manipulated the battle to ensure his loss, his brother Hoelio's death, and his subsequent suicide. The empire's collapse into tribal barbarism was deliberate. A unified Lumina threatened Shadow control. A fractured Lumina was fertile ground.

    By the end of Phase 2, the Shadows had proven they could destroy empires without anyone knowing they existed.

    Phase 3 in Action — The Baoth Disaster¶

    The Shadows' Phase 3 centerpiece was Baoth — intended to become a pan-continental super-state that would consolidate all cultures under a single centralized authority. With Baoth as the vehicle for global unification and the Shadow-controlled Erisian church providing ideological legitimacy, Phase 4 would have followed naturally.

    It collapsed. The Demon King discovered the infiltration, destroyed Baoth, and shattered the Shadow-homunculi psychic link. The Erisian church launched anyway — but without Baoth's prestige, it became a localized human religion rather than the global faith it was designed to be. It still serves the Shadows. It still controls the Pontificate. But Phase 3 never reached its intended scale.

    Phase 4 — Armageddon (Current)¶

    The Shadows have abandoned subtlety. Phase 4 is Armageddon — named for the device that anchors it. The Armageddon device sits on Romanium Island, deep in the Shadow base, and is a weapon of chaos: activated, it spreads destruction across the world. It is not the only instrument — the goblin army of Pontus, The Groom's detonation, and the Church's manufactured prophecy are separate instigations the Shadows have been working for years, meant to fire alongside it. The Shadows control the Armageddon device and can, technically, stop or deactivate it — it is a tool, not a trap.

    The plan: trigger the Armageddon event — device + goblins + the rest — to drown the world in chaos, then let the Erisian church "save" it: global conquest in the name of order. Once every being on Ge'or is under the Church's control, Phase 5 — the planetary hivemind — begins. Phases 5 and 6 will follow.

    If Everything Fails¶

    The Shadows have a final contingency. If all plans collapse — if Armageddon is stopped, if their network is exposed, if the world unites against them — they will destroy the entire world. They will unleash something that kills every inhabitant of Ge'or.

    Including themselves.

    And in the same stroke, they will harvest. Their last plan is not mere destruction: every dead soul on Ge'or is folded into a hivemind — the assimilation they could not achieve over the living, taken from the dead. If they cannot rule Ge'or, no one will — and nothing will remain unclaimed.

    The Shadows are patient. They are methodical. They are architects of control. But if they cannot rule Ge'or, no one will.

    The Erisian Church — The Perfect Fabrication¶

    The Shadows' greatest achievement on Ge'or is the Erisian church. It is not merely a religion. It is a weapon — designed to centralize human governance under a single faith, backed by divine-right legitimacy and enforced by crusades.

    The Woman Who Never Was¶

    In the region of what is now the Pontificate of Eris — the land where Eris was supposedly born — a woman appeared. She claimed to be the incarnation of the goddess of Discord, Chaos, and Confusion — the deity who commanded all other gods of the universe.

    She was a homunculus passing as human. No one knew.

    She performed miracles. She would chant down enormous monsters — creatures the Shadows themselves had implanted in the region — and the people watched in awe. She could not be killed: she suffered multiple assassination attempts, each time "dying" only to reappear, reborn. The Shadows faked every death.

    But she would not cure the sick. She would not heal the wounded. When ordinary people begged for miracles, she refused — telling them they were not worth it. The truth was simpler: she could not perform real miracles. Everything she did was staged. Curing the sick would have exposed the fraud.

    The Teachings¶

    Her message was carefully designed to serve the Shadow agenda:

    • Kill your enemies. Violence sanctified by faith.
    • Live ascetically. Do not accumulate wealth for yourself — donate it. To her.
    • Trust order and the government. They are divine institutions. Obey them.
    • The poor must give as much money as they can. Wealth flows upward to the Church; the Church flows to the Shadows.
    • Baoth fell because they did not listen to her. She claimed responsibility for the destruction of Baoth — stealing the Demon King's sacrifice and repurposing it as proof of her power.

    She also claimed — and this is recorded in The Eris Saga — that she was born in an orgy. This is an enduring embarrassment for the Erisian cult, which officially forbids orgies. Other religions use this contradiction to critique them.

    The Departure¶

    When her purpose was complete, she "left" Ge'or. She sank into the earth — "to become part of the universe again" — and was never seen again. The Shadows retrieved the homunculus body and disposed of it.

    Immediately after, The Eris Saga was compiled — the holy text of the new faith.

    The Church Militant¶

    Instigated by the Shadows through their remaining agents, Eris's first followers:

    • Created holy orders — military-religious organizations answerable only to the faith.
    • Conquered lands in the name of Eris, forcing countries to convert.
    • Founded the Pontificate of Eris — the seat of the Church and, secretly, the operational headquarters of the Shadow plan on Erisdar. Shadows coordinate their next moves from inside its walls.
    • Launched crusades — waves of holy war that expanded Church control and eliminated resistance.

    The entire Pontifical council is composed of homunculi or willing human collaborators who know about the Shadows and worship them. The Church is not merely infiltrated. It is owned.

    • Centralization — the Empire as the "sword of the Church."
    • Elven persecution — elves are genetically immune to the hivemind (see below). They must be eliminated or marginalized.
    • Divine magic — framing mage-cells as holy gifts keeps the population from understanding what they actually are.

    Elves — The Immunity¶

    Elves cannot be absorbed into the Shadow hivemind.

    During The Last Great War, the elven species genetically modified themselves to resist Shadow brainwashing and information extraction. An elf cannot be turned, cannot be mind-read, cannot be converted into a Shadow puppet. Their minds are closed to the hivemind.

    This makes elves the single greatest threat to the Shadow plan.

    The Shadows' response was to fabricate a mythology: elves are evil. Elves are enemies of mankind. Elves should be hated unconditionally.

    This propaganda was most successful in Central Erisdar — specifically in the Erisian Empire, the Erisian Theocracy, and the Pontificate of Eris. These church-aligned states institutionalized elven hatred. The Great Elvish Persecution of 137 AGD was a Shadow operation.

    Outside Central Erisdar, the hatred is weaker. Many nations never bought the propaganda. And even within the Empire, attitudes have been shifting — elven craftsmanship (goods, art, architecture) has been driving tolerance. People who buy elven goods are less likely to believe elves are monsters.

    The Shadows are aware of this erosion. It concerns them.

    The Armageddon Plan¶

    The Shadows have a plan for total victory. It is called Armageddon. The timeline: some years after 597 AGD.

    The Weapon¶

    Armageddon is a weapon that will trigger a global ice age. Famine. Mass death. The collapse of every decentralized state on Ge'or. Billions will die.

    The purpose is not genocide. It is regime change. Countism — the decentralized political system that has frustrated Shadow control for millennia — cannot survive an ice age. In its place, the Shadows will install hardline dictatorships across every continent. Centralized states are easier to control.

    The Simultaneous Attacks¶

    When Armageddon activates, three things will happen at once:

    1. The Goblin Army Emerges — From the Pontus subterranean complex, the Shadow-controlled goblin horde will pour into eastern Erisdar. The Fractured State of Erislod, Dwarvengor, the Silver Republic, the Erilian Federation — all will face a coordinated assault from a direction no one expected.

    2. The Groom Explodes — The ancient reactor vortex in the Formingar Ocean will complete its detonation cycle. Tsunamis and underwater explosions will ravage coastlines across multiple continents. The Demon Continent, Kutten, Lumina, and Erisdar itself will all be hit.

    3. The Pontificate Declares Prophecy — The Pontificate of Eris will announce that this is the fulfillment of the prophecy of Eris. The end times have come. All faithful must gather at Eris. The global population will be called to Central Erisdar — into the waiting arms of the Church, which is the waiting arms of the Shadows.

    The Endgame¶

    With the world's population consolidated, the Shadows will:

    • Impose global rule.
    • Develop the magical-technological systems necessary for mass soul absorption.
    • Create the hivemind.
    • Restart the Last Great War — and win.

    Current State (597 AGD)¶

    The Shadows are not yet ready. Armageddon is planned but not yet triggered. Their current priorities:

    • South Sun Empire — the Shadows have recently installed eunuch homunculi in the emperor's court. The Emperor of the South Sun Empire is siding with the Shadows. He is described as a twisted individual — corruptible, useful.
    • Global intelligence — the Shadows have studied and detailed every continent, every nation. They have privileged information on all of them.
    • Goblin army preparation — the Pontus complex continues to breed, train, and equip goblins.
    • Elven tolerance erosion — the Shadows are concerned about rising elven acceptance and may accelerate persecution.

    Known Counter-Forces¶

    • The Demon King — discovered the Shadows' infiltration of Baoth, destroyed the city, shattered their psychic link. The greatest setback the Shadows have suffered on Ge'or. They did not see him coming.
    • Hermes Kennensbach — the Emperor suspects something is wrong with the Church. He has never said so publicly. He does not know about the Shadows. But he smells the rot. The Shadows have tried to co-opt him and failed.
    • The Ironcloak — descendants of the Old Earth rebel faction. They know pieces of the truth.
    • Elves — genetically immune. Cannot be absorbed. The Shadows' eternal problem.
    • Countism — the decentralized political system of Ge'or. A world of a thousand counties is harder to control than a world of ten empires. The Shadows built countism's opposite — and countism won.
